name: Sanctuary of Isthmian Poseidon, Isthmia
text: Isthmia was an ancient sanctuary of Poseidon on the territory of the ancient city-state of Corinth and located on the Isthmus of Corinth in Greece. It was famous in antiquity for the Isthmian Games and its Temple of Poseidon. Today it is an important archaeological site with museum.

depictions.name: Sanctuary of Isthmia
depictions.text: Isthmia (ancient city) The Sanctuary of Isthmia was a sanctuary located west of Korinth in Korinthia, Greece. In classical antiquity, it was known for its temple dedicated to the god Poseidon, who served as one of the protectors of Korinthia. During the Peloponnesian War the sanctuary was visited by the Spartan misthios Kassandra
